answer.rationale: p99 write latency is 5x and confined to the primary region during peak settlement writes. That regional localization is a stronger present signal than the overlapping release, so the closest prior is memory_b2 (clean regional shift, latency back in minutes). Rollback (memory_b1) remains a live alternative because the release is only two hours old, but it does not explain a primary-only blast radius. Circuit breaking (memory_b4) would shed or fail writes and conflicts with not losing customer writes. Failover at settlement peak can still endanger in-flight or lagged writes, so downstream settlement value is flagged and root cause is left open pending the b2 archive.
